question: Aparna Satheesan, a recipient of 2021 Abhinandan Saroja National award by National Institute of Classical Dance, is an exponent of _______ and Kuchipudi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Aparna Satheesan** is a renowned classical dancer and an exponent of Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi.
 
• She was awarded the prestigious **Abhinandan Saroja National Award in 2021** by the National Institute of Classical Dance.
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest and most traditional classical dance forms of India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is characterized by intricate footwork, graceful movements, and expressions that depict stories from Hindu mythology.
 
• Aparna Satheesan has been recognized for her remarkable contribution to preserving and promoting Bharatanatyam globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam**

 
 
• Bharatanatyam is believed to have originated over 2,000 years ago and follows the Natya Shastra, an ancient treatise on performing arts.
 
• The dance form is performed by combining rhythmic movements (Nritta), expressive gestures (Nritya), and dramatic storytelling (Natya).
 
• The costumes and ornaments used in Bharatanatyam are traditional and vibrant, emphasizing cultural heritage.
 
• This dance form is often performed in temples as a form of devotion and spiritual expression.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi**
 
 
• Kuchipudi is another classical dance form of India originating from Andhra Pradesh.
 
• This dance form combines drama, music, and dance, with performers often enacting mythological stories.
 
• Kuchipudi is known for its unique style that includes singing and speaking dialogues while dancing.
 
• It requires high levels of skill and is performed both solo and in groups.
 
 
 
• **Abhinandan Saroja National Award**
 
 
• This prestigious award is presented by the National Institute of Classical Dance to honor exceptional contributions to classical dance.
 
• The award recognizes individuals who have significantly contributed to preserving and promoting Indian classical dance forms.
